name: Po Dara
bio: Po Dara brings the River Lotus from Champa with ceramic jars. He does not trust a trader who cannot tell a jar he bought from one he merely used for packing.
notes: fact: Champa was served with the China and Ryukyu communities by one shahbandar, and Champa traffic came with the northeast monsoon (docs/research/port-official.md §3; docs/research/commodities.md, Monsoon Patterns)
inference: Regional ceramic traffic makes a coaster with ceramic jars plausible, without establishing Po Dara's exact cargo or port (docs/research/commodities.md, Porcelain)
gameplay: The River Lotus is a Champa coaster with glazed jars for sale. Po Dara wants return pepper and seeks business independent of the Guangzhou owners (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §08)

gameplay: Ask about the Champa stop and he can corroborate the wet-silk story, not the Tioman stop. Accuse him of Hamzah's dealings on that evidence and he takes his jars to buyers outside Melaka (data/inspections/case_001.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
